union.summary: Todo checklist left unchecked for steps that this very diff completed, while the paired design doc already calls the fix "shipped" — the task file is stale/inconsistent with its own PR.
union.evidence:
The checklist reads:
- [x] Reproduce + root-cause (markdown-it lheading + list interrupt guards)
- [ ] Add `packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts`
- [ ] Wire it into `preview.ts`
- [ ] Unit tests in `preview.test.ts` (...)
- [ ] Note the deviation in `docs/design/notes/notes.md`
- [ ] Draft PR
but this same diff adds `packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts`, wires it into `preview.ts` (`md.use(listEmptyBulletPlugin)`), adds the five described unit tests to `preview.test.ts`, and adds the notes.md subsection — i.e. four of the five unchecked steps are actually done in this PR. Meanwhile `docs/design/notes/notes.md:275` titles the new subsection "— shipped (issue #517)", implying completion, which conflicts with the todo file's own unchecked boxes for the work that subsection describes.
